title: AlwaysStats
description: A lightweight customizable HUD mod that displays stats without pressing F3
body:
A simple & lightweight customizable HUD mod to always display the stats you want.

![Ingame Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a465a7c4602483afb91f9bfd1ed382bfc3b12102.png)

Made because I just wanted to always see some specific stats, slowly working on customizability!

Heavily work in progress.

This is my first mod, please give all the feedback you feel like :) Or add issues/further suggestions to additions and I will try my best to get it done!
